verdict.rationale: Cactus's own CLI documents converting any Hugging Face model by name with `cactus convert [HF-Name]`, and `cactus run` runs models locally, but the vendor labels this HF path experimental. Community hands-on use shows models downloading via GGUF links but the demo app crashing on selecting Jan Nano and SmolLM3, so HF model support is unproven in depth. Missing for 10: a non-experimental, documented direct HF download-and-run flow, a list of supported architectures, and independent corroboration that converted HF models run reliably.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can download and run open models directly from Hugging Face

citations.quote: Any HuggingFace model can be converted using cactus convert [HF-Name], though experimental.
Step 1: brew install cactus-compute/cactus/cactus - Step 2: cactus run
Downloading Jan Nano or SmolLM3 via the GGUF link worked
